bibl.title: A New Column in P.Lond. I 121 (Pap.Graec.Mag. VII): Edition and Interpretation.
bibl.seg: Raquel Martín Hernández, A New Column in P.Lond. I 121 (Pap.Graec.Mag. VII): Edition and Interpretation.
bibl.note: P. Lond. I, 121 = P.G.M. VII (= MP3 552 + 1868 + 6006; van Haelst 1077; LDAB 1321). - 1. Description of Pap.Graec.Mag. VII, scribes and content. - 2. A new column for Pap.Graec.Mag. VII. - 3. Edition of the text. - 4. Whose hand: that of the main scribe or of someone else? - 5. The new column in relation to the codicological structure of the text.
